transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

Hi, doctor. Thank you so much for seeing me. Um... I guess the main thing that pushed me to make an appointment is, well, it's probably not a huge deal, but I've been having a little trouble at work. 

I process insurance claims, and... well, I keep getting up from my workstation during the day. Even when I know I’m really supposed to just stay put and finish my claim reviews. I'm not trying to slack off or anything, I promise! I just... I sort of end up wandering away from my desk when I shouldn't. I really want to do a good job there, so I figured I should probably ask someone about it. Is that... does that make sense to start with?
What usually prompts you or goes through your mind when you find yourself getting up from your desk?

Um... well, like I was saying, it’s mostly just that I keep getting up from my workstation when I really know I’m supposed to just stay put and finish my claim reviews. As for what goes through my mind... it’s honestly not a conscious choice to avoid work, I promise. 

I might just think, "Oh, I should grab a quick sip of water," or I'll just feel like I need to stretch for a second, and before I even really process it, I’m already up and walking away from my desk. It's never because I want to ignore my job, I really do try to be a good employee. I just sort of... drift out of my chair without meaning to. 

Does that answer your question? I hope that doesn't make me sound completely irresponsible...
Aside from getting up from your desk, do you find yourself making careless mistakes or having trouble keeping your focus on the details of your claims?

Oh, um... no, not really. I actually try to be super careful with the details. I mean, insurance claims are really important, so I always double-check my work to make sure I don't mess up anyone's coverage. 

I don't think I make careless mistakes... at least, my supervisor hasn't said anything about it. Even when I do get up, when I sit back down I make sure to review what I was looking at so I don't miss anything. I really do try my absolute best to be accurate. Is... is it okay if I don't have that problem? I hope I'm giving you the right kinds of answers.

Oh, um... no, I don't think so. I mean, I care a lot about doing things right, obviously, but I wouldn't say I'm a worrier. I don't really sit around stressing or feeling anxious about a bunch of different things every day. I actually try to stay pretty upbeat and positive! 

It's really just... just that weird habit of wandering away from my desk that I can't seem to shake. I don't feel overwhelmed with worry or anything like that. Is that what you meant? I hope it's okay that I don't have a lot of anxiety... I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Do you often find yourself easily distracted by everyday sights or sounds happening around you?

Um, well... I guess I do get a little sidetracked sometimes, but nothing too crazy, I promise. Like, our office is pretty open, so if people near me start talking about another claim or something, I might just... accidentally tune in for a second? Or sometimes I'll just suddenly remember some random errand I have to run after work. 

When that happens, my attention kind of just... slides off what I'm reading. I usually catch it right away, though! I just have to go back and reread the same section a few times to make sure I got it right. It's really not that bad, and I always make sure I understand the claim before moving on. I hope that doesn't make me sound like I'm not paying attention to my work... is it normal to get a little distracted like that in a busy office?
Do you often have trouble organizing your tasks, managing your time, or keeping your work and materials in order?

Um, well... maybe just a little bit? But I think it's mostly just because my caseload got a lot bigger recently. I try really hard to keep everything neat, I promise! It's just... sometimes my claim folders and my sticky notes, and, like, my email flags kind of end up a little all over the place. 

It's not that I'm a messy person or anything! It just gets a bit hectic, and I end up having a hard time figuring out which policy review I should tackle first. But I always get it done eventually! I just want to make sure I'm prioritizing things right. Is... is it normal to struggle with that a little when work gets super busy? I really hope that doesn't make me sound like a bad employee...
In your everyday life, do you frequently forget to do routine things, like keeping appointments, paying bills, or running errands?

Um, well... I guess I do forget a few things here and there, but nothing major like paying my bills or missing doctor appointments! I'm pretty good about my personal stuff. 

It's really just... at work, sometimes. I guess I forget some of the smaller follow-ups a little more than I'd like to admit. Like, um, I might mean to return a claimant's call, or update a diary note on a file, or send out a form... and then I just kind of realize at the end of the day that I didn't do it. 

I always catch it the next day, though! I just... I get so focused on trying to get the main parts of the claims done that some of the little extra steps slip my mind. I really try my best to stay on top of it, though. Do you think that's just because I'm trying to handle too many claims at once? I hope it doesn't sound like I'm being careless... I really do care about doing a good job.
Do you often find yourself misplacing or losing things that you need for work or daily life, like your keys, phone, or paperwork?

Um, well... I wouldn't say I *lose* things permanently. I mean, I always find them! It's just... I guess sometimes I misplace things for a minute or two. 

Like, I'll be working on a claim and then I'll realize I don't know where the physical form went, even though I swear I just had it in my hand. Or I'll set my headset down to grab a coffee, and then I have to spend a minute hunting for it when I get back to my desk. Sometimes it's a sticky note with a claimant's callback number, or... well, sometimes I've even misplaced my office access badge, just for a little bit! 

But I always find them pretty quickly, I promise! I just... I think I just set things down without thinking when I'm trying to juggle a bunch of different tasks. That happens to everyone, right? Just, like, temporarily misplacing things when you're busy? I really try to keep track of my stuff, I don't want you to think I'm irresponsible or anything.
